name: 17754 · Montoursville, PA
findings: ZIP 17754 (Montoursville) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17754 (Montoursville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17754 (Montoursville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
